posts.title: What tender committees in Guyana check on ISO certificates | Preqal
posts.description: A tender committee does not read your quality manual. It checks who accredited the certificate, and that takes about two minutes. Here is what it looks for.

posts.title: What happens after the ISO 9001 certificate arrives | Preqal
posts.description: Most ISO 9001 systems pass the audit and then stop being used. The three ways a quality system goes quiet, and four questions that show where yours stands.
